lines.text: Jesus and His disciples sail across the lake, and when a windstorm swamps the boat, they wake Him.
Jesus rebukes the wind and the waters, and the frightened disciples ask who commands even the winds.
In the region of the Gerasenes, a demon-possessed man living in the temple falls before Jesus.
The demons beg to enter a herd of pigs, Jesus permits it, and the herd rushes into the river.
The people find the man clothed and in his right mind, and Jesus sends him to tell what God did.
